## 🖥️ Put Nod to work in your apps

Nod can now use apps on your Mac or Windows computer. Ask it to write a list in TextEdit or Notepad, fill a table in Numbers, or write a Mail draft.

Try telling Nod: “Open TextEdit and write a shopping list: milk, bread, eggs. Don’t save it.”

Turn it on in **Settings → Computer use**. On a Mac, also allow Accessibility. Computer use is experimental and off by default. It works only on work you start. Nod checks changes against your request, and you can select **Stop** while it works. You can also tell Nod to keep out of an app.

Computer use does not work in the Linux Flatpak app yet. [See setup and limits](https://nod.n8n.io/docs/connect/computer-use/).

## Also in this release

- **Schedules:** Select **Stop this run** to end the current run and keep future runs enabled. Late, skipped and failed runs show what happened in chat.
- **Fresh chat:** Send `/clear` to start fresh. Your files, apps, memory and schedules stay. Previous messages remain in chat search.
- **Desktop updates:** Interrupted Windows downloads can resume, and downloaded updates install when you quit. Mac updates can finish if you reopen Nod during installation.
- **Writing in chat:** Fixes for pasted links, text formatting and fast typing keep the message box working as you write.
